decision: Sam's blanket decision of 2026-11-19 suspending per-case test admission until 2026-11-26 (PM agentmsg 60f733a4, CI admin d1d3ef37), with one non-author review by the Claude TL claude-erp-app-tl-01, who also ruled this change (agentmsg dd1580ef) and reviewed it with no Required (a69c2c72); one-off SCOPE for this receipt file granted in a69c2c72.
purpose: The Supplier HTTP harness read its route list from the api.registration.completed summary, which is close to the system logger's maxEntryBytes and becomes a [TRUNCATED] string once over it, failing every harness test. It now reads the per-route api.registered entries and checks their count against registeredApiCount.
data: No data change: the harness reads the system log the app already writes.
thresholds: No threshold change; the route reader now fails if the per-route count differs from registeredApiCount.
trigger: Routine functional server integration tests through existing discovery; one PR CI.
cost: No new case; the reader parses the same log lines. Not a measured CI cost.

cases: Supplier integration suites that build their app through createSupplierHarness (route list read from the system log)
